• **National sports Awards 2022**

 
 
• The National Sports Awards are an annual set of awards given by the **Government of India** to recognize and honor outstanding achievements in sports.
 
• The awards are presented to** athletes, coaches,** and othe**r sports-related personnel **for their exceptional performances and contributions to the field of sports.
 
• In 2022, the National Sports Awards were presented in a virtual ceremony on **August 29, 2022**, due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**

 
 
• The Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award is the highest sports award in India, and it was conferred upon **one athlete** in **2022**.
 
 
 
• **Arjuna Award**
 
 
• The Arjuna Award is given to recognize outstanding achievements in sports, and it was awarded to** 33 athletes **in 2022.
 
 
 
• **Dronacharya Award**
 
 
• The Dronacharya Award is given to coaches for their exceptional performance in the field of sports coaching.
 
 
 
• **Dhyan Chand Award**
 
 
• The Dhyan Chand Award is given to recognize lifetime achievements in sports.
